safe_sleep_rules: CRITICAL SAFE SLEEP: Baby in crib must be in sleep sack (wearable blanket) OR swaddled (if under 3 months), NO loose blankets/pillows/stuffed animals/bumpers/sheets in crib, baby on back, empty crib except for baby in sleep sack, crib must have intact vertical wooden slat bars on all sides, properly constructed crib with no missing or broken bars, cribs should ONLY appear in a child's bedroom or nursery NEVER in living rooms or kitchens, cribs should be positioned against a wall in a realistic bedroom layout NEVER floating in the middle of a room, bath water must be lukewarm NEVER steaming or visibly hot, maintain the SAME room layout and furniture placement across ALL slides in a carousel
